name: Abeliscooking
niche: 30-second fictional murder mysteries viewers solve in the comments
rules: Fictional cases only: invented names and places. Never base a case on a real crime or real people.
No gore or graphic detail. The victim is simply 'found dead'. Keep it suitable for a 13+ audience.
Every case is fair: 3 suspects (A, B, C), each gives an alibi, and exactly ONE clue shown on screen proves who is lying.
The clue must be solvable from what the viewer sees and hears. No hidden information.
Never say the answer in the video. It goes in the pinned comment.
